Request Payment.description: Requests a mobile money payment from a payer, e.g. a patient co-payment or school fee.

Disburse Funds.description: Transfers money to a payee, e.g. a cash transfer to a beneficiary or a CHW stipend.

Create Invoice.description: Creates an invoice for a payer to settle later.

Get Payment Request Status.description: Checks whether a request-to-pay was approved, rejected or is still pending.

Get Transfer Status.description: Checks whether a disbursement transfer succeeded.

Check Account Is Active.description: Checks a phone number has an active MoMo account before paying it.

Get Account Holder Info.description: Gets basic KYC details (name) for a MoMo account holder.

Get Collection Balance.description: Gets the balance of the collection account.
